liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Reviewer hears a monster opener to set two, with impassioned Garcia leads; Reviewer singles out the China Cat into Rider pairing as a highlight [27][30]
- **The Other One** (1 review, 1 other source): The last three minutes of Space leading into The Other One are called stunning; The Other One track includes the Space section [6][32]
- **Down In The Bottom** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer hears hard-core late-1984 Dead in Down In The Bottom into I Ain't Superstitious; This song was patched from a source supplied by Robert Bryant and Scott Clugston, remastered to match the soundboard [4][28]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): Reviewer believes it was the first time the band opened a show with this then-new song [26]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Rider commanding, with a thick, heavy sound [27]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer says not to skip the Wharf Rat that follows The Other One [32]
- **Day Tripper** (1 review): A New Yorker in the crowd shouted "Revolution" at Jerry just before the encore Day Tripper [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **Superstition**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [36]
- **Meet Me On The Bottom**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [36]
- **Sunshine Daydream/Encore Break**: rare: 13 archived performances [36]
- **Day Tripper**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 6 archived performances [36]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Tons Of Steel [36]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-12-28.Senn421.Darby.118250.Flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 139 min [1]
- **gd1984-12-28.142611.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 21 songs; 146 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd84-12-28.aud.unknown.16584.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 139 min; rated 4/5 by 14 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this recording very nice, better than the more recently posted FLAC copies [30]
- **gd1984-12-28.167626.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 140 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Garcia was in bad shape around these shows, though this one still had rough energy [25]
- Steve Parrish's family died in a car crash after this show, leaving the remaining New Year's shows subdued [26]
- Reviewer notes Steve P.'s wife's death after the show dampened the remaining nights, and that six weeks off helped Garcia [27]
- Photographer shot many of the show's photos from the photo pit, posted online [33]
- Reviewer says the New Year's shows were starting to decline compared to a few years earlier, with pre-New Year's shows generally better [24]
- Reviewer calls this the best show of the New Year's run [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-12-28.Senn421.Darby.118250.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; SennheiserMD421's (PAS/DFC/OTS Row 4)> Sony TC-D5m,Tapes Sony Metallic; Transfer Information:Tascam 112 MKII (XLR… [1]
- **gd1984-12-28.142611.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master > Reel (Technics) > Dat (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) [4]. Also: Soundboard sourced from DATs provided by Rob Eaton, with pitch correction settings from Joe B. Jones [4]
- **gd84-12-28.aud.unknown.16584.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience cassette > ? > DAT > CDR > SHN [5]
- **gd1984-12-28.167626.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Oade's Schoeps source supplies crowd sound, Touch Of Grey's opening notes, and short patches in Drums and Sugar Magnolia [6]

## Art and photos
